create_sgd_classifier: create an SGDClassifier with hinge loss for linear SVM classification using stochastic gradient descent
create_sgd_regressor: create an SGDRegressor with squared_error loss for linear regression using stochastic gradient descent
create_sgd_one_class_svm: create an SGDOneClassSVM for unsupervised outlier detection using stochastic gradient descent
train_sgd_classifier_partial_fit: train an SGDClassifier incrementally using partial_fit for out-of-core learning on large datasets
train_sgd_with_early_stopping: train an SGDClassifier or SGDRegressor with early_stopping to terminate when validation score stops improving
